Privacy Policy

Last updated: 20 October 2026 · Applies to the RasoiOne apps for Android, Windows and Mac, and to rasoione.shop

In short: Your billing data stays on your own device. We have no cloud that stores your bills or your customers. We do not run ads and we never sell data. The only data that reaches us is what is needed to sell and activate your licence.

1. Who we are

RasoiOne is a product of DriftsAI ("we", "us"). Contact: support@rasoione.shop · WhatsApp [+91 XXXXX XXXXX]. Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act), the shop owner is the Data Fiduciary for the customer data the shop records in the app. We are the Data Fiduciary only for the licence, payment-reference, referral and support data described below.

2. Data that stays on your device — we never receive it

This data lives in the app's private storage on the shop's phone, tablet or computer. We never receive it. Two copies can exist outside the app, both controlled by the phone's owner, not by us: Android's own backup (if it is on in the phone's settings, Android may copy app data to the owner's Google account, so a new phone can restore it), and backup files the owner chooses to share or save.

  • Bills, sales, menu, prices, stock, expenses, staff, attendance and reports.
  • Customer names, mobile numbers, birthdays, anniversaries, notes and loyalty points that the shop chooses to record (all optional).
  • Orders received through the table QR menu. The customer's phone shows an order QR; the shop scans it. The order never passes through any server.

3. Your shop Wi-Fi (phone and computer sync, table QR orders)

When a phone is paired with the shop computer, bills and the menu travel between them over the shop's own Wi-Fi, directly, not through the internet or our servers. This local link is not encrypted, so use a Wi-Fi network only the shop controls (with a password), not a public one. Pairing needs the owner to confirm the computer's address and a 6-digit code.

4. Scanning purchase bills

Reading a photo of a purchase bill uses Google ML Kit text recognition on the phone. The photo is not sent to us. Google may collect basic usage and diagnostic data from the ML Kit library under Google's terms.

5. Table QR menu

The printed table QR contains the menu itself (dish names, prices, shop name). When a customer scans it, rasoione.shop only delivers a fixed web page; the menu is read from the QR on the customer's own phone and is never sent to us. The customer's order is kept on their phone until they show it to the shop. We do not collect customer names or numbers from the menu page.

6. Optional backup to your own Google Drive

If you turn on backup, the app saves backup files to your own Google Drive. We use the limited drive.file permission, which only lets the app see files it created. We cannot open your Drive or your backups. Phone-to-computer sync works over your own Wi-Fi or your own Drive.

7. Licence data (our licence server)

When you start a trial, buy or activate a licence, or renew online services, we store: name, mobile number, email (optional), licence key, plan, the date your online services end (and, for keys sold earlier as subscriptions, the date the paid time ends and any AutoPay status), the Razorpay order and payment ids, and a random device id that limits how many devices one key can use. We use this only to issue and check your licence, provide online services, stop misuse and give support. The licence is signed so the app can check it without internet.

8. Payments

Payments are processed by Razorpay. Your card, UPI or bank details (and any UPI AutoPay or card mandate from an earlier subscription) are handled by Razorpay and your bank; we never see or store them. Razorpay's privacy policy applies to the payment. If you paid through the Google Play Store or Apple App Store, that store's policy applies.

9. Referral programme

Each paying shop gets a referral code. When a new shop buys with a code we record the code, the new licence key, the plan and the first payment, so we can pay the referrer. Referrers who want payouts give us their name, mobile and UPI id. Referrers never see the new shop's data.

10. Feedback and crash reports

If you send feedback or a crash report from the app, it opens WhatsApp or email with the text filled in; nothing is sent until you press send. A crash report contains the app version, device model and the error, not your bills or customers.

11. What we never do

  • No advertising and no ad trackers.
  • We do not sell, rent or share personal data for marketing.
  • We do not read your bills or your customers' data.

12. How long we keep data

Licence and payment records: while the licence exists and as long as Indian tax law requires (usually 8 years for invoices). Free-trial records: 3 years, only to allow one trial per shop. Referral payout records: as for payments. Support chats: up to 2 years.

13. Your rights

Under the DPDP Act you can ask to access, correct or erase your personal data, and withdraw consent. Data on your device: delete it in the app (a customer's data can be exported or deleted from their profile), clear the app data, or uninstall. Licence data: see rasoione.shop/delete-data.html or write to us. We reply within 7 days.

14. Shops: your duties to your customers

Record a customer's details only with their consent, use them only for your shop (bills, loyalty, birthday wishes), and delete or export them when the customer asks — the app has buttons for both.

15. Children

RasoiOne is a business tool for shop owners and is not directed at children under 18.

16. Grievance Officer

[Grievance Officer name] · support@rasoione.shop · [Business address, City, State, PIN]. We acknowledge complaints within 48 hours and resolve them within 30 days.

17. Changes

If we change this policy we update the date above and, for important changes, show a notice in the app.
